acceptance.requirement: Personal, Campaign and Session contexts remain explicit, with parent context/connectivity/cadence shown when relevant.
Role/capability labels are contextual and never imply global GM/Player account identity.
Decision, result, waiting, recovery, informational and creator-advisory items are projected from owning domains rather than duplicated into a second workflow engine.
Notification classes are defined with durable source/context/deep-link and current-authorization requirements.
Creator and waiting notifications can be quieted/batched without streaks, punitive overdue states or repeated nagging.
Deep links reauthorize and re-resolve current target/version, with safe recovery for permission, version, deletion and connectivity changes.
Personal, reusable, Campaign-local, Sandbox and spoiler-filtered material have explicit accessible semantics; unauthorized hidden material is absent, not styled.
Spoiler Shield changes presentation of already-authorized material only and cannot grant/revoke access or reveal hidden cardinality.
Search, counts, badges, recents, related-work and notification summaries filter by authorization/visibility before aggregate/rank/render.
Protected search/results/counts/assistance scope are invalidated or re-evaluated on context switch.
Cached content is labeled and bounded by owning policy; reconnect revalidates authorization/version before protected projection.
Ambiguous prior mutations route to owning-domain status/idempotency recovery rather than blind retry.
Context, attention, search and safe recovery remain usable on mobile.
Keyboard and screen-reader paths convey context, role, information class, notification state and recovery without relying on color or layout.
No essential state depends on animation.
Shell copy is warm, calm and concise without blame, fake urgency or obsequiousness.
All APW-06 core behavior is deterministic and useful with no AI provider.
Design grants no application implementation, migration, notification delivery, security-by-spoiler-shield, release or deployment authority.
